title: Campaign Data Analyst
text: Campaign Data Analyst at Ashdown People (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). An exciting opportunity for a newly created role within a fast-growing online business for a Campaign Data Analyst who has a solid understanding of call center operations and online customer experience. This organization has had phenomenal success over recent years, and are looking to do a complete overhaul of their current systems to keep up with the rapid growth. The company is based in Sydney CBD. It has a modern lively, fun office feel with all the bells and whistles. The company have fantastic retention and promote from within. Responsibilities include: Translating business strategy into customer and prospect lists and conducting quality checks on output Creating data files for targeted marketing / tele sales campaigns and customer communications Build datasets that are the single version of the truth on campaigns; performance & deliver the results into self-serve dashboards using tableau Develop and evolve appropriate metrics, processes and tools to provide actionable reports, analysis, data Partner with marketing and commercial teams to execute targeted campaigns across multiple channels typically including email, display, SEM, SEO, telesales and event based triggers Evolving the maturity of the organisation in terms of campaign/data/lead management data processes and measurement of marketing and sales effectiveness (working with an experienced Leadership Team) The desired candidate will have exceptional data skills, ability to learn the business, innovate by designing new processes, and effectively consult on the design of data execution processes. They will also be confident with an outgoing disposition and be analytically passionate. If this sounds like you, don't hesitate, apply now! rebecca.bird@ashdownpeople.com.au
